recognize_zh: 同一視野可同時看到三種線索：箭頭指的鈍端、有稜角的 HbSC 結晶，雙箭頭指的靶形紅血球，以及箭形標記處細長尖端的鐮刀型紅血球，另外還有許多摺疊、濃縮的紅血球，符合 HbSC 疾病。
features: Red cell with dense, blunt, angular hemoglobin crystal protrusions (arrow)
Many folded, irregularly contracted and dense red cells
Adequate platelets; a polychromatic cell present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells (double arrow), many folded and irregularly contracted dense red cells, and cells containing blunt, straight-edged hemoglobin crystals (arrow). An occasional elongated sickle cell is present (arrowheads), and a polychromatic red cell is seen. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin SC disease, to be confirmed by hemoglobin HPLC or electrophoresis.

ddx.vs: HbSS has many thin, pointed sickle cells and fewer target cells, and lacks blunt SC crystals.
HbCC shows target cells with rhomboid/hexagonal HbC crystals but no sickle cells.
HbS/beta-thalassemia shows microcytic hypochromic cells with sickle and target cells, and HPLC shows HbS with elevated HbA2 and no HbC.
